description: We’re the team behind FlamePrint, a NASA Space Apps project that uses real NASA data, explainable AI, and interactive 3D to explore how fire behaves in microgravity. We bring skills in software development, machine learning, data analysis, and design. We’d love to work with teammates interested in space science, data visualization, or science communication who want to make complex research easier to explore and understand.
summary: Unlike flames on Earth, flames in microgravity behave differently due to the absence of buoyancy-driven convection. They can develop spherical shapes, experience altered oxygen transport and heat distribution, and persist under unexpected conditions. Flame-Print helps users visualize these differences and explore how oxygen availability, materials, and environmental conditions influence combustion. By combining NASA research with intelligent analysis and interactive simulations, Flame-Print aims to advance fire prevention, improve spacecraft safety, and contribute to safer missions to the Moon, Mars, and beyond.
details:
Flame-Print, developed by Team SHAGHAF, is an AI-powered platform that transforms NASA's microgravity combustion research into interactive scientific analysis and spacecraft fire safety insights.

The platform integrates OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol with a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system connected to NASA's PSI research archive, containing 21 CSV datasets and 1,987 records. Users can explore scientific findings, ask questions, and receive evidence-based explanations supported by NASA sources.

Using Decision Trees and Logistic Regression, our Explainable AI system analyzes CFI-G experimental outcomes, visualizes predictions, and explains the influence of different variables.

Our interactive 3D environment, developed with Three.js and WebGL, allows users to explore an orbital station, compare flames on Earth and in microgravity, and experience our Predict, Prevent, Isolate (PPI) fire safety framework.

Built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, and Docker, Flame-Print combines scientific research, intelligent analysis, and immersive visualization to help understand fire hazards, explore prevention strategies, and support safer future space missions.
